articleTitle: Charging of electric vehicles and impact on the grid
abstract: This paper surveys some basics of the electric vehicle and battery charging technology. The focus is on battery charging technology and fast charging possibility. Impact on the grid is studied for different charging methods and for a case study, grid design is considered.

articleTitle: Method cooperation in optimization process
abstract: This paper describes some ideas for method cooperation in optimization. Many methods for optimization have problems in some cases. Usually those problems don't persist if we will change method. We wanted to show how methods can be forced to cooperate in solving optimization problem. As one method we will use Particle Swarm optimization (PSO) method. This method can get stuck in local minimum. There are improvements of this method like Repulsive Particle Swarm optimization method (RPSO). Basic PSO is working with “best known solution”. This solution is usually found by particles from swarm but it can be injected by external cognition. We will present how the system for optimization can be designed as an open system. This design can accept any method that will be coded in future. The open system will be able to accept different methods and use them as solvers. Designed open system has subsystem which is mastering set of optimization methods (mentioned PSO, random shooter, etc.). Those methods are working together like multiagent system. The cooperation of agents-methods can combine advantages and eliminate disadvantages of individual methods.

articleTitle: European projects for support of mechatronic fields at Brno University of Technology
abstract: This paper deals with two European projects of a mechatronic team at Brno University of Technology. These European projects "Knowledge and Skills in Mechatronics Innovations Transfer to Practice" and "MINOS" provide opportunity for knowledge improvement and advancement of the mechatronic team and students of mechatronics at Faculty of Mechanical Engineering.

articleTitle: Cooling of new designed machine
abstract: This paper deals with aspiration to offer a special cooling system for enclosed induction machine which operates in explosive environment. This is particularly relevant to electric devices in power plant, or other predisposed applications, where machine arrangement complexity has to be kept to a minimum. A new design was developed to improve heat exchange with a low-pressure drop. A new internal fan was developed to match internal airflow requirements and cooler characteristics and reduce noise. Heat is dissipated much more efficiently due to a redesign in the internal air flow circuit configuration which increases the heat exchange area and air flow.

articleTitle: Subpixel corner detection for camera calibration
abstract: Many different interest point detectors have been proposed with a wide range of definitions for what points in an image are interesting. Corner points are interesting as they are formed from two or more edges and usually define the boundary between two different objects or parts of the same object. Interest points are generally more abundant in real images than straight edges and are considered to be the most important features, they are attractive due to their high information content and hence they are ideal features for tasks such as camera calibration, object tracking or fast interpretation of a robot's environment. Therefore, we present a comparative study of different subpixel interest point detectors combined with the use of finding interest points using the different corner measures proposed by Harris and Stephens and Interest operator by Haralick.

articleTitle: Automatic measurement of the antenna directional characteristics
abstract: There are several important antenna characteristics that should be considered when choosing an antenna for your application. The directivity and radiation pattern are very important characteristics. Measurement site includes not only electrical, but the mechanical equipment too. One of most important problems is the synchronization of data acquisition with antenna rotation system. The paper describes the measurement site design for automatic measurement of antenna directional characteristics. The hardware and software design is proposed. The results of automatic measurements are data in graphical or text form for antenna directivity, gain and frequency bandwidth evaluation. Some results of experiments are presented.

articleTitle: Methods of statistical evaluation of data from long-term measurements of soil temperature profile using open-source tools
abstract: This paper describes the statistical evaluation of collected data from measuring the temperature of the soil profile to determine the thermodynamic parameters of the soil thermal collector. Data analysis is aimed at determining the periodicity of changes in temperature, heat transfer parameters depending on the depth, thermal conductivity and accumulation characteristics of soil thermal collector. To save the measured data, there was used relational database server MySQL, for the data evaluation there were used numerical libraries for data processing of Python programming language, for data visualization there was used application Scidavis and to post data to a web site there were used modules modpython and matplotlib of the Python programming language.

articleTitle: A data integrity in distributed .NET applications
abstract: If we develop a .NET distributed application by .NET Remoting we have to often solve a race condition problem. For example, trying to access a server-side object on more than one client at once in this application is inherently dangerous. Locking enables us to obtain exclusive access to a server-side object that is used by another client. It is built into Microsoft Visual Basic 2008 through the SyncLock statement or the System. Threading. Monitor .NET class. This paper shortly describes the locking techniques. In a conclusion it demonstrates the use of locking in the sample distributed .NET application with a threaded client and shows complete listings with commentaries of all source files of this application.

articleTitle: Automated reconstruction of 3D object
abstract: The contribution treats the topic of automated system of reconstruction of the shape of 3D objects. There are different methods of reconstruction of 3D objects or 3D scene. In contribution presented system belongs to the category of the active methods of reconstruction enabling to gain model of the object, whose geometrical dimensions in ideal case correspond with real object dimensions. For the purpose of reconstruction laser source of plane beam that creates light spot on the scanning object was used. The light spot was taken by the colour CCD camera. The reconstructed object was situated on the outdoor pan/tilt scanner head enabling object rotating toward the camera ranging from 0° to 350°. The advantage of this method is the fact that it is possible to accomplish 3D reconstruction only by one camera. Presented principle is used in many applications, for instance in the diagnostics and in checking the quality production.

articleTitle: Determination of air permeability of a linen material
abstract: This article covers a method to estimate air permeability based on a time-dependent transmission of air flow through a sample. There is a large efficiency because of increased signal/noise ratio in the process of estimation, which provides higher accuracy for the technological process (removing contamination). In general case, an estimated parameter of pressure, Up(t), can be expressed as: U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>(t) = ξ(t)·f(t) + η(t), 0 ≤ t ≤ T, where f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>(t) is a function of pressure change in time; ξ(t), η(t) are multiplicative and additive components of error; T is a measurement time period. It is showed here that noise ratio of time-dependent method less than noise ratio of stationary method.

articleTitle: New subject “Energy Harvesting” for education of mechatronics
abstract: This papers deals with the new subject for education of mechatronics in Brno University of Technology. The new subject “Energy Harvesting” is prepared for students of the master study programme mechatronics. This subject presents overview of power sources for autonomous mechatronic applications. Nowadays power sources can be classified as energy reservoirs (batteries, super-capacitors, fuel cells, etc.), power distribution methods (wiring, laser, RF, acoustic, etc.) or energy harvesting methods. This new subject deals principally with unique ways of generating energy from surroundings of engineering systems.

articleTitle: The possibilities of utilization of mobile pulsed radar sensors
abstract: The risk of collision between birds and aircrafts has been known since the time when birds and aircrafts started to occupy the same airspace. The majority of bird strikes today occur at or around airports. The paper analyses a possibility of bird and other object detection in airfields using pulsed radar sensor. The paper deals with the possibilities of utilisation of mobile pulsed radar sensor. There are analyzed possibilities of small object detection by pulsed radar sensor. The results of detection possibilities of small objects and real raw digitized radar data are presented. In the paper there are derived formulas for probability of object detection focusing on small objects. There are presented some results of radar cross section analyses. The paper presents some results achieved in the project of applied research.

articleTitle: Program system for signal processing in innovative education and research
abstract: New program system dedicated for education and research purposes is described in this paper. The system comprises block packages that include basic and advanced modules for signal processing. The basic modules consist of fundamental topics and concepts from signal and system theory, like correlation, convolution, Fourier transform etc. The advanced modules include applications in different areas like acoustics and biomedicine.

articleTitle: Mathematics model design based on genetic programming
abstract: The illustrative example of application of genetic programming on the area of economics system is described in this paper. With application of genetic programming can be designed model which corresponds with real data of gross domestic product. We compare three ways of determining of gross domestic product. Genetic programming is also suitable for creating the mathematical models of soft systems. It is possible to use them even for modelling of the diagnostics mechatronics systems.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of different types of hybrid electric vehicles
abstract: The paper deals with review of hybrid electric vehicles (HEV) for light vehicle, brief history of making and development. Also there is analysis existed HEV and its manufacturers. The classification of HEV is presented. HEV of three main types are considered. For each of types a principle of operation, main advantages and disadvantages, and their schematics and describing of main parts of it are considered. This paper consists of analysis of combined operating of internal combustion engine (ICE) and electrical motor for different types of HEV, and their functions in HEV. Typical driving cycles, its differences and specific character of engines (ICE and electric motor) are considered.

articleTitle: CNC machines diagnostics
abstract: Mechatronics is an exhaustive coverage of the various aspects from design to testing of high technology computer numerically controlled (CNC) machines. With the introduction of advanced features on CNC machines and with the introduction of flexible manufacturing system (FMS) and computer integrated manufacturing (CIM) diagnostic systems to detect wear and breakage assumed importance as the operation on such systems are normally unmanned or minimally manned. A large number of systems are available for automatic tool monitoring on CNC machines. The basic monitoring principles are as follows: registration of tool working hours, measurement of output power, measurement of cutting forces, geometric measurement of tools or products. Need to diagnose not only tools, but also to diagnose the machine modules. For diagnostics of machines modules and elements is necessary to apply artificial intelligence (AI) techniques.

articleTitle: Application of Kalman filtering to acoustic sound diagnostic measurement
abstract: Application of Kalman filtering theory to data processing is a well-known. Many books and articles is devoted to radar targets tracking, as classic example we introduce, as a book more different applications can by introduced. The development theory and practice continues and we would like present one possible new application. The paper deals with problems of Kalman filter application to acoustic sound diagnostic measurement. The approaches are aimed to measurement data processing. There are results of application to the real acoustic signals of car engine are presented.

articleTitle: Magnetostrictive sensors in mechatronics
abstract: There are many needs for high precision, small and realtime sensors for various measurements in mechatronics. Our paper focus on the presentation of the main principles and application possibilities of sensors that incorporating magnetostriction effects. This paper shows our recent results of magnetostricion sensor development especially of sensors of mechanical quantities.

articleTitle: Synthesis and analisys of hybrid mechatronic systems for contact tasks
abstract: The aim of this paper is to present some key problems at creation of hybrid mechatronic systems for contact operations-assembly, grinding and polishing on multipositioning robotic workstations.

articleTitle: Bond graphs and its use in mechatronics
abstract: The article deals with bond graphs method which is useful in order to display structure of dynamic systems as well as to its analysis. Block diagram of bond graphs method is shown. It is possible to transform graphs into block diagrams for numerical simulation or into differential and algebraic equation system. Rules for bond graph construction in mechanical and electrical system are stated. Simulation state schemes and state equations present block diagrams which are alternatives to graphical representation of system dynamics in the sense of power bond graph. At state scheme, signal transfer is given by power and energy variables e, f, p, q. Dynamics is modelled with elementary energy accumulators, i. e. integrators which is an advantage. Additional blocks in state schemes are additive block and statical nonlinearity.

articleTitle: CPN model of the MODBUS protocol
abstract: Coloured Petri Nets (CPN) has been developed as a modeling language mainly for the parallel processes and communication protocols. CPN were used for modeling of various protocols, i.e. TCP/IP or CAN. In this paper it is presented CPN model of the MODBUS over serial line protocol, which is defined on the 2nd layer of ISO/OSI reference model. The model of MODBUS protocol (Figure 1) consists of model of master device, several slave devices and communication network. Each of connected slave devices has its own configuration stored in place confl (or conf2). MODBUS over serial line protocol defines master/slave communication principle.

articleTitle: Numerical impedance analysis of thin wire dipoles
abstract: The article deals with the Method of Moments used in analyzing the impedance of thin wire dipoles from current distribution. This is very practical interest, as realistic antennas can be modeled by wires whose radius is smaller than their length and the wavelength. The article introduces the Pocklington's integral equation for thin straight wire and delta-gap source model. The equation is solved by the application of the moment method using pulse functions and point matching technique. The MATLAB script file was also created to introduce the results in a graphical manner. The results are compared with other references and professional simulation software.

articleTitle: Magnetic field in aerial toroidal and poloidal coil system arrangement
abstract: The aim of proposed paper is to present the magnetic field calculation in aerial toroidal and poloidal coil systems arrangement. The magnetic system is in principal very similar to the Tokamak configuration. The coil models have been done in 2-D axisymmetry and/or in 3-D, depending on geometric arrangement and excitation of coils. The finite element method (FEM) was used in all analyses. The calculation of 2-D and 3-D electromagnetic quantities were performed in magneto-static mode and also in magneto-transient mode coupled with external circuit. Poloidal coil arrangement and magnetic field calculation were performed in 2-D axisymmetry in magneto-static mode. Meanwhile, the toroidal coil system requires a 3-D geometric model description.

articleTitle: Design of algorithm of inverse viewing transformation with using multistage correlation analysis of stereoimage
abstract: Today, according to product automatisation systems, which are used for building of three dimension models of technological environment, enginery and machinery, became widespread. Many modern fast - acting scanning laser systems are used only in unmanned situations because of danger for human. It means development of passive optical systems of three - dimensional vision. In this work algorithm of inverse viewing transformation is suggested, which based on determination unknown parameters of system of equations for point in three - dimensional space: v(x, y, z) = A(ρ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, ρ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, φ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, φ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, θ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, θ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, d)· w(x<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, x<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>), where w - vector of screen coordinates, v - vector of coordinates of point in three - dimensional space, A - generalized matrix of rotation and transfer. Common area of images is detected using correlation analysis with optimization of computational complexity and growing of data accuracy on each step of calculation of correlation function of images of object.

articleTitle: R&D infrastructure creation using virtualization and simulation
abstract: How the virtualization can be used for research and development purpose across the corporate and enterprise by integrating it with other technologies? I would like to cover the integration of the virtual, real and simulated networks for research and development purpose of geographically spread organizations with diverse divisions. This will address the development of complex systems eliminating the bar of distance and skill set by developing the independent modules and integrating them. Also the purpose is to effectively use the underlying resources for research and development purposes so as to effectively control the costs associated with it. Today it is very common that research and development departments of big organizations are spread across the different geographical locations. Research and development in corporate also has become complex and large. It is no more restricted to just innovations, but also includes integrating different new innovations or new innovations with old applications. In this context it is very important that infrastructure exists that allows engineers in different location to innovate independently and then integrate them to solve some standard or known industry problem. This paper suggests a solution to such issue. Most importantly it does not cost much in today's freeware environment to create this type of infrastructure.

articleTitle: Supercapacitor for engine cranking
abstract: The super-capacitor SC, due its low internal resistance, can reduce the SLI battery size, prolong its lifetime and improve the starting ability of internal combustion engine ICE namely at low temperature or at worn-out battery. To verify the SC suitability the DYNAST model has been prepared, where various influences can be examined. The actual model includes important resistances and inertias as well as speed reducer between the electric motor (starter) and ICE crankshaft. The results from one-cylinder four-stroke Diesel engine for low-power generator drive are presented.

articleTitle: Affect of operation conditions of triple half bridge series resonant inverter for harmonic distortion and power factor
abstract: The main aim of this paper is to discusses the change in harmonic distortion and power factor by the variation of operation conditions of a triple half bridge series resonant inverter circuit (THB-SRI). THB-SRI topology allows the control of three outputs, simultaneously and independently, up to their rated powers saving component count compared with the three half bridge solution. Results of this study can be used as an aid in component selection and understanding the affect of operation conditions to the other circuit parameters. Details of the study are presented along with simulation results.

articleTitle: Mechatronics in a household - sound recording
abstract: This paper deals with question whether mechatronics is only privilege of the industry or if it is possible to find its commodities in an ordinary household. As a sample comparison of the older and nowadays players and sound recorders and theirs accessories was chosen. A Digital portable sound recorder Zoom H4 was tested to be able to say whether it do help to user or doesn't.

articleTitle: Acoustic emission signal processing of the pressure relief valve
abstract: The basic parameters of the pressure relief valve are the flow rate through the valve and the level of hydraulic fluid pressure. Both parameters are easy to measure in laboratory conditions but very often quite troublesome in common process conditions. That is why we are looking for additional approaches to substitute the direct flow rate and pressure measurement. One of them is acoustic emission measurement and consequent and convenient data processing. The intensity of acoustic emission generated by fluid power elements can be evaluated in various ways. The frequency range for consecutive evaluation, which is application dependent, can be established experimentally only. The paper discusses the possibilities of acoustic emission measurement and data processing in the frequency range above 25 kHz. The FFT analysis was performed for evaluation purposes and the CFD simulation in the Ansys CFX environment was carried out as well.

articleTitle: Elaborating of electronics for vacuum device
abstract: The elaborating of vacuum device control system is considered in the article. That device enables to fix automatically some parts for its machining as well as to choice of electromagnetic valves' control components, algorithm and program.

articleTitle: Building of a flexible (adaptive) structure for mechatronic system's repair cycle
abstract: Mechatronic system's service model on a base of its elements' reliability level estimation is offered. The application of an adaptive structure for repair cycle creates the base for organization of predictive maintenance and operational effectiveness increasing for mechatronic systems.

articleTitle: Remote control system and its development for linear asynchronous motor
abstract: The paper deals with the remote control of linear motor. Concept of linear motor and its benefits are described. For providing remote control system which is possible to monitor by Internet the basic types of distance control systems are studied. Communication between motor and a computer is usually realized by serial port (RS 232 or RS 485) which is not suitable for our solution. For that, serial port communication by USB was chosen and USB adapter was designed. Circuit design of data processing system is based on PIC microcontroller. The remote control system of the linear motor is described via software product LabView.

articleTitle: Motor for easy-mover
abstract: To move a heavy roll of paper or a reel with cable through an industrial hall to the distance of a few meters using manpower is a drudgery. Due to this fact, the workers use a simple mechanical device powered by compressed air to move heavy reels. However, the air pressure hose is the main disadvantage of this solution: The free movement is restricted. Our task is to develop the same device (EasyMover), powered by an electrical motor and supplied by accumulators.

articleTitle: Serial tightening screw connections
abstract: This article describes the principles of tests designed to serial tightening screw connections in the mass production of low-voltage electronics. Primarily ensure minimum deviation from the preset torque. Requirement is that the bolt connection will be always tightened the required torque, which ranges units Ncm. The tests are aimed at tightening electric hand tools, and influence the quality of tightened joints. These tools have a potentially large impact human factor, which also the article deals with.

articleTitle: School 3-Axis CNC surfacer
abstract: Nowadays in industrial concerns, it's more and more usual to use machine tools with digital control. It might be a big advantage if the control program is changed very often. This article describes the project and the construction of a simple school but precise 3-axis CNC surfacer designed for shaping of wood, plastic and light metal alloys with maximal dimension of 400 × 300 × 200 mm. The assumed accuracy is 0.005 mm. Movement is solved by step motors and bright bolts with nut with balls. The machine tool is portable and is controlled by an usual PC.

articleTitle: Analysis of the influence of quantization error at sensor autocalibration
abstract: The paper treats the auto-calibration of sensors based on the test method that allows correction of additive, multiplicative and linearity error of sensor. Test method is based on the local approximation of nonlinear conversion function by linear dependence. The degree of approximation depends on parameters modifying measured signal. Paper presents the analysis of relationship among mentioned approximation parameters and quantization error of A/D (analog to digital) converter used for test method realization by microcomputer. Knowledge of those relationships allows definition of the requirements on values of modifying parameters of the described method and A/D converter resolution.

articleTitle: Callibration metodology for micro-nano robotic systems
abstract: The subject of this paper is robotisation of cell-injection process and in particular development of a virtual model of micro-nano robot and calibration of the structure. To cover all requirements as high-speed, fine positioning and orientation preloaded stack piezo-actuators with closed loop are selected.Main issues of methodology for microrobot calibration are presented.

articleTitle: Modeling of non-repaired items reliability in mechatronics systems
abstract: The article deals with a general model which describes reliability of the group of non-repaired items applied in a construction of a repaired mechatronic system under condition that non-repaired items are preventively replaced by new ones at regular intervals. The model enables us to estimate mean operating time between failures (MTBF) and other parameters of all the mechatronic system. The suggested model also enables us to carry out the analysis of the effect of changes of single input parameters which influence a resulting value MTBF. A practical use of the presented model is illustrated on an example of reliability calculation of the group of the electric drive bearings.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic and constructional design of welded induction machine
abstract: This paper deals with electromagnetic and constructional design of a new induction machine, which is specific with its construction, as it is designed to be composed only of metal plates. This machine is designed to work in dusty and explosive atmosphere of a coal mill, hence it utilizes double circuit cooling. The coal mill working conditions also require a high moment of inertia, which affect the design of machine's rotor. High dynamical stress of coal mill working conditions also affect the complete mechanical and constructional solution of the machine. This machine furthermore does not utilize any external cooler, since its outer sides are designed to work as coolers. In case of necessity it is also possible to use a standard external cooler.

articleTitle: Image generator framework
abstract: This paper covers basics of image generation mainly used for computer vision purposes to test new algorithms. It deals with visualization in 3D space in common Win32 environment with use of OpenGL and C++. The main idea is to obtain proper visualization image data which can be used as an image source for computer vision algorithms within simulation. In addition this concept allows that the tested computer vision algorithm and the image generator are booth in the same project. This significantly speeds up developing and testing of new algorithms.
